scope: United States / national / completed calendar months

definitions.x: MoM percentage-point change in model share of the selected Google AdOps demand/search segment
definitions.y: MoM percentage-point change in model share of its native SRS retail segment
definitions.search_share: model Google AdOps indexed opportunity volume / selected-segment Google AdOps volume
definitions.retail_share: model SRS retail units / that model's unchanged native SRS segment retail units; special segmentation never changes retail share
definitions.industry_retail_share: model or Hyundai SRS retail units / total SRS industry retail units for the same month and geography
definitions.inventory_share: model Cloud Theory average inventory / that model's unchanged native Cloud Theory segment inventory; special segmentation never changes inventory share
definitions.demand_inventory_x: inventory share / retail share; 1.0 is parity
definitions.demand_inventory_y: search share / retail share; 1.0 is parity
definitions.conversion_x: monthly SRS retail units / average Cloud Theory inventory; Sales Velocity
definitions.conversion_y: monthly SRS retail units / Google indexed search-opportunity volume; Conversion
definitions.model_matching: exact ius_make_model for competitors; Hyundai-only nameplate rollup within the same segment
definitions.governance_source: Governance List Revised.xlsx / Full Set (149 governed model rows)
